method: Headlines collected via web search (fetch_news.py collector blocked in sandbox; use it for local/Actions runs). Entity sentiment scored by Claude during the weekly Cowork routine. sentiment = 0-100 D-favorability of coverage tone (matches existing dashboard sentimentScore semantics: >55 leans D, <45 leans R). candidateSentiment = 0-100 favorability of coverage toward that candidate personally. outletLean: -2 left ... +2 right (AllSides-style); null = unrated outlet, excluded from scatter.

races.matchup: Susan Collins (R, inc.) vs. Graham Platner (D)
races.summary: Coverage frames Collins as more vulnerable than in any prior cycle after Platner's upset primary win over Gov. Mills. Polls split — UMass Lowell has Platner +5, Fox News has Collins +3 — and massive GOP outside money ($65M+ committed) is itself a recurring 'Collins in trouble' storyline.

articles.headline: Maine Poll: Platner Holds Slight Lead over Collins in U.S. Senate Race
In pitch to voters, Susan Collins touts funds for Maine, Senate seniority
Susan Collins leads Maine Senate race by 3 points in Fox News poll
Susan Collins Within Striking Distance of Graham Platner in Maine — Poll

races.matchup: Hannah Pingree (D) vs. Bobby Charles (R) vs. Rick Bennett (I)
races.summary: Post-primary coverage treats Pingree as the clear favorite in a state Harris won by 7. The three-way dynamic with independent Rick Bennett is the main source of uncertainty in coverage.

articles.headline: Maine resolves ranked choice primaries, setting up the governor's race and a key House contest

races.matchup: Open (Peters retiring) — D primary Aug 4: McMorrow / El-Sayed / Stevens; R: Mike Rogers
races.summary: Coverage is dominated by the contested Democratic primary — AOC's endorsement of El-Sayed is the week's biggest story. Rogers is treated as the presumptive R nominee. General-election sentiment won't sharpen until after Aug 4.

articles.headline: Ocasio-Cortez endorses Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan Senate race
AOC endorses Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan Senate race

races.matchup: Jocelyn Benson (D) vs. John James (R) — primaries Aug 4
races.summary: Benson leads recent polls and coverage improved after Duggan's independent bid collapsed in May, consolidating the D field. Her 'Costs Down, Wages Up' tour is earning steady positive local coverage; James coverage is comparatively thin.

articles.headline: New Poll Shows Jocelyn Benson Leading Michigan Governor Race
New poll shows Benson pulling ahead as Duggan slips despite big spending
Benson establishes firewalls for 2026 election, recuses herself from gubernatorial race decisions

races.matchup: Jon Husted (R, appt.) vs. Sherrod Brown (D)
races.summary: A genuine dead heat in coverage and polls: RCP average has Brown +0.6 while Emerson shows Husted +6. Brown's $8M small-dollar haul vs. Husted's record R fundraising gives both sides a strength narrative. Right-leaning outlets emphasize Trump's endorsement of Husted; mainstream coverage emphasizes Brown's comeback framing.

articles.headline: Sherrod Brown wins Ohio 2026 Democratic Senate nomination, AP reports
Husted, Brown set stage for Ohio's 2026 U.S. Senate race
Sherrod Brown chances of ousting GOP's Jon Husted in Ohio Senate race — Polls
Ohio 2026 Poll: Senator Husted Starts Matchup with Six-point Lead Over Sherrod Brown

races.summary: Emerson has it 46-45 Acton — far closer than Ohio's recent statewide baseline, which is itself the story. Acton is breaking D fundraising records ($11.5M in 2026, outraising Ramaswamy) while Ramaswamy counters with a $25M personal loan. Coverage tone is slightly Acton-favorable on momentum.

articles.headline: Game on: Ramaswamy, Acton race to become Ohio governor
Ohio 2026 Poll: Democrats Make Gains in Races for Governor and US Senate
In Ohio gubernatorial race, Amy Acton outraises Vivek Ramaswamy in 2026

races.summary: Cooper's lead is widening in coverage and polls (Carolina Journal +11, Catawba/YouGov +14). Whatley's severe name-recognition deficit (52.7% don't know him) is a recurring theme. Counter-narrative: GOP legislature launched a probe of Cooper in April — the main negative Cooper storyline.

articles.headline: May 2026 — Cooper's lead over Whatley in Senate race widens
Roy Cooper's North Carolina Senate race could help decide control of the next Congress
Polls show Roy Cooper with strong lead over Michael Whatley for North Carolina Senate seat
As NC's US Senate race heats up, GOP lawmakers launch probe of Dem candidate Roy Cooper

races.matchup: Jon Ossoff (D, inc.) vs. Mike Collins (R)
races.summary: Even Fox News's own poll has Ossoff +13 over Collins, with strength among independents (68%). The bruising Collins-Dooley runoff (Collins won 55.5% with Trump's endorsement) left R coverage focused on party disarray — Time's 'Now It's a Mess' framing is representative.

articles.headline: Jon Ossoff leads Mike Collins by double digits in Georgia Senate poll
Georgia Senate race 2026: Trump and Ossoff exchange attacks after Collins wins GOP nomination
Republicans Saw Georgia as a Top Pickup. Now It's a Mess

races.matchup: Open (Kemp term-limited) — R runoff: Burt Jones vs. Rick Jackson; D field led by Keisha Lance Bottoms
races.summary: Coverage centers on the R runoff endorsement war: Trump backs Jones, while Jackson landed the Kemp-Deal-Perdue triple endorsement — a proxy fight for the Georgia GOP's direction. D primary coverage led by Bottoms with Duncan, Esteves, Thurmond trailing. General-election tone unresolved.

articles.headline: Georgia Governor Primary Runoff Election 2026 Live Results

races.summary: NYT/Siena has Hinson just +2 — inside the MOE in a state Ds haven't won statewide since 2018, which is why CNN moved Iowa onto its most-competitive list. The 'Iowa is actually in play' framing dominates; Hinson's Trump endorsement (73.9% primary win) anchors the R counter-narrative.

articles.headline: New polling, national rankings point to competitive Iowa Senate race between Hinson, Turek
Polls: Iowa U.S. Senate race tight, Sand leads for governor
Iowa Senate primary results: GOP's Ashley Hinson, Dem Josh Turek to vie for open seat

races.summary: The MAHA-backed Lahn's sub-1-point upset of Trump-endorsed Feenstra is covered as a GOP shock — 'party voters rejected Trump's late endorsement.' Sand leads general-election polls and set a state petition-signature record. Cook rates it Toss-up; coverage tone leans Sand.

articles.headline: MAHA-backed Zach Lahn defeats Trump-backed Randy Feenstra in Iowa GOP primary for governor
Rep. Randy Feenstra concedes to Zach Lahn in 2026 Iowa GOP gubernatorial primary

races.matchup: Joe Lombardo (R, inc.) vs. Aaron Ford (D)
races.summary: Primaries settled it: Lombardo vs. Ford, polling a dead heat. Coverage notes it's the only Cook toss-up with an R incumbent seeking re-election. D strategy of tying Lombardo to Trump (tariffs, immigration, Iran) vs. Ford's bid to be Nevada's first Black governor are the dueling narratives.

articles.headline: Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo to face off against Democrat Aaron Ford in Nevada's race for governor
Nevada's 2026 Governor's Race: Lombardo and Ford Locked in Early Dead Heat

races.matchup: Open (Evers retiring) — 8-way D primary (Barnes, Hong lead) vs. Tom Tiffany (R, Trump-endorsed); primary Aug 11
races.summary: An 11-candidate field. Coverage is process-heavy: the crowded D primary (only Barnes and Hong above 10%) against Tiffany's consolidated R lane. Widely framed as a pure toss-up given the state's even lean; expect tone to sharpen after Aug 11.

articles.headline: Wisconsin's crowded governor's race remains crowded after filing deadline
Wisconsin's wide-open 2026 Democratic primary for governor

races.matchup: Katie Hobbs (D, inc.) vs. R primary Jul 21 (Biggs, Schweikert)
races.summary: Hobbs enters with a record $12M raised and no primary challenge, while she brands the R primary 'a race to the bottom.' Polls range from Hobbs +1 over Biggs to +19 — the spread itself is the story. Robson's dropout narrowed the R field.

articles.headline: Republicans' chances of defeating Katie Hobbs in Arizona governor race — Poll
Arizona governor's poll shows Katie Hobbs' chances of beating Andy Biggs
Katie Hobbs calls Arizona GOP primary 'a race to the bottom'

races.matchup: Open (Shaheen retiring) — Chris Pappas (D, Shaheen-endorsed) vs. R primary Sep 8 (John Sununu, Scott Brown)
races.summary: First open Senate race here since 2010. John E. Sununu's entry moved ratings from Lean D to Tilt D — the 'improved GOP odds' framing dominates. Pappas has the party consolidated; Sununu vs. Brown is the R storyline until Sep 8.

articles.headline: John Sununu formally joins race to replace Jeanne Shaheen in Senate
New Hampshire Senate: Sununu Bid Boosts Republican Chances

races.matchup: Kelly Ayotte (R, inc.) vs. TBD (D primary Sep 8)
races.summary: Coverage is one-sided: Ayotte is 'politically strong,' with decent polling and fundraising and no top-tier D challenger declared — the lone declared Democrat calls beating her 'insanely unlikely.' Solid R-hold tone unless a serious D enters.

articles.headline: Ayotte begins her second year in office politically strong — but with looming challenges
After one year on the job, N.H. Governor Ayotte announces new reading, nuclear power initiatives

races.matchup: Open (Kelly term-limited) — R: Masterson frontrunner, Schwab; D: Holscher, Corson, Skoog; primary Aug 4
races.summary: The only D-held governorship up in a double-digit Trump state. Coverage treats Senate President Masterson as the R frontrunner; the late Skoog entry shook up an otherwise quiet D field. Tone tilts R-pickup.

articles.headline: Who's running for Kansas governor? The field is officially set
2026 primary election: Who is Kansas governor candidate Ty Masterson?

races.matchup: Kurt Alme (R) vs. Alani Bankhead (D) vs. Seth Bodnar (I, Tester-backed)
races.summary: Daines's last-minute withdrawal and hand-off to Alme still shapes coverage. The Tester-backed Bodnar independent bid is the wild card that keeps this from being a pure R-hold story, but forecasters rate it Lean/Likely R and tone follows.

articles.headline: Steve Daines' handpicked Senate successor Kurt Alme vows to keep Montana in Republican hands in 2026
Democrats' Odds of Flipping Montana's GOP Senate Race as Steve Daines Bows Out

races.matchup: Dan Sullivan (R, inc.) vs. Mary Peltola (D) — top-4 primary Aug 18, RCV general
races.summary: Polls split: NYT/Siena Sullivan +2, Alaska Survey Research Peltola +5-6. The FBI/state investigation into the 'second Dan Sullivan' ballot scheme is the dominant storyline and injects chaos into an already close RCV race.

articles.headline: The Dan Sullivan saga in the Alaska Senate race is under investigation, sources say
Sullivan holds slim lead over Peltola in NYT Alaska Senate poll
In Alaska's US Senate race, Peltola and Sullivan support most big resource development projects

races.matchup: Pete Ricketts (R, inc.) vs. Dan Osborn (I)
races.summary: Rematch dynamics favor a close race: Osborn polls neck-and-neck, outraised Ricketts in Q1, and got a clear lane when D primary winner Cindy Burbank signaled she'd step aside. Coverage treats a Ricketts loss as plausible, which is itself notable in Nebraska.

articles.headline: Nebraska's Osborn outraises Ricketts in Q1 of Nebraska U.S. Senate race
Pete Ricketts' Nebraska Race Tightens as Field Clears for Osborn

races.summary: Paxton's 63.8% runoff rout of Cornyn — the first Texas senator denied renomination since 1970 — is covered as a watershed that Democrats believe puts the seat in play with Talarico. Still a Likely R state, but the volatility framing has raised D-competitiveness tone well above the Texas baseline.

articles.headline: Ken Paxton defeats John Cornyn in Texas U.S. Senate GOP runoff
Texas Senate race: Democrat Talarico wins; GOP's Cornyn, Paxton in run-off

races.matchup: Greg Abbott (R, inc., 4th term bid) vs. Gina Hinojosa (D)
races.summary: Correction to the dashboard: Abbott is NOT term-limited — he's seeking a fourth term with a $96M war chest and Trump's endorsement. Polls range Abbott +5 to +6; Hinojosa's NBA Finals ad buy was the first general-election spot. Closer-than-usual tone for Texas.

articles.headline: Democrat Gina Hinojosa launches first ad of Texas governor's race
Tight race in Texas governor election: Abbott vs. Hinojosa
